name: hud_layout_base_enable
description: HudLayoutBase::Enable dispatches the layout set-active slot with active=1.
known_limits: Tier C first; the existing VC target hud_layout_base_enable_disable covers the Enable/Disable pair.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly and decompilation for 0x412bf0 validate loading the layout ftable from self, pushing active value 1, and indirectly calling slot offset 0x04.
The native layout shutdown smoke installs a test SetActive slot, calls HudLayoutBase::Enable, and verifies the dispatched active value is 1.
